units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 3:8">Shebi. III, 8</cite> <he>לא יִסְמוֹךְ בעפר</he> one should not support the dam by packing earth upon it, v. <cite ref="O00063"><he>סָבַךְ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 5">Gen. R. s. 5</cite> <he>סְמָבָן וכ׳</he> he crowded them between &c. (<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 10">Lev. R. s. 10</cite> <cite ref="U01496"><he>שָׂמָן</he></cite>); a. e.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 136:6">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXXXVI</cite>, <he>עוג היה … וסוֹמְכוֹ</he> Og broke a mountain loose and threw it on the Israelites …, Moses took a pebble and mentioned the Holy Name over it and stemmed its fall; <he>הידים שכך סוֹמְכוֹת</he> the hands which thus stem (the mountain); <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 1">Deut. R. s. 1</cite>, end; a. e.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:2:2">Y. Sabb. III, 5ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>אפי׳ לִסְמוֹךְ לו</he> even to place a vessel close to it (to be warmed); Bab.
<cite ref="Shabbat 38b">Sabb. 38ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 2:3:2">Y. Kil. II, 27ᵈ</cite> <he>סוֹמְכִין עומרין וכ׳</he> you may put packed sheaves by the side of &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 2:7">Kil. II, 7</cite> <he>לסמוך לו וכ׳</he> to plant closely adjoining to it &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 2:8">Ib. 8</cite>; a. fr.—Esp. (sub. <he>יד</he>)

senses.gloss: to press hands on the head of a sacrifice (to indicate ownership).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 9:8">Men. IX, 8</cite> <he>הכל סוֹמְכִין וכ׳</he> all persons are entitled to lay hands on their sacrifices, except &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 2:2">Ḥag. II, 2</cite> <he>שלא לסמוך</he> that the laying on of hands must not be done on the Holy Days.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 2:3">Ib. 3</cite> <he>ואין סומכין עליהם</he> but hands must not be laid on them; a. fr.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: to lay hands on the head of a scholar, in gen. to ordain.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 14a">Snh. 14ᵃ</cite> the government decreed <he>שכל הסומך יהרג וכ׳</he> that whosoever ordained a scholar should be put to death, and whosoever be ordained should be put to death, <he>ועיר שסומכין וכ׳</he> and the town wherein the ordination takes place &c.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 14a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>וס׳ שם חמשה וכ׳</he> and he ordained there five elders.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 14a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>ר״מ לא סְמָכוֹ ר״ע</he> that R. Akiba never ordained R. M.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 14a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>סומכין בארץ ונִסְמָכִין וכ׳</he> if those ordaining stand on Palestinean ground, and those to be ordained outside of Palestine; a. fr.
senses.label: b

units: <cite ref="Berakhot 9a">Ber. 9ᵃ</cite>, a. fr., v. <cite ref="K00128"><he>כְּדָיי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Eruvin 65b:21">Erub. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>נִסְמוֹךְ על וכ׳</he> let us rely on the opinion of &c.; a. fr.—Trnsf.

senses.gloss: to support; to find support for an opinion or a rule, (v. אַסְמַכְתָּא).
units: Y. Shebi. X, 39ᶜ bot. (ref. to Deut. XV, 3) מיכן סָמְכוּ לפרוזבול וכ׳ here they found a support for the prosbol as a Biblical institution, expl. בשהתקין הלל סְמָכוּהוּ וכ׳ when Hillel had instituted it, they supported it by reference to &c.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: (with ענין) to bring under the same rule laws which are joined in the Biblical text.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 4a:5">Yeb. 4ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 22:17">Ex. XXII, 17</cite> a.

<cite ref="Exodus 22:18">18</cite>) <he>סמכו עניין לו וכ׳</he> they brought the subject (verse 17) close to it (verse 18) (to intimate) as the punishment for the one is stoning, so is it for the other.

Ib. וכי מפני שסמכו וכ׳ can we put a person to death on an intimation suggested merely by the neighborhood of two subjects? (v. סְמוּכִים, infra).—Part. pass. סָמוּךְ; f. סְמוּכָה; pl. סְמוּכִים, סְמוּכִין; סְמוּכוֹת a) near, close by.
<cite ref="Megillah 3b:3">Meg. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>וכל הס׳ לו</he> and all (the inhabited area) adjoining it.
Men. 98ᵃ, a. e. על בס׳ the preposition ʿal means immediately on.
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 131:1">Sifré Num. 131</cite> <he>הרבה פרשיות ס׳ וכ׳</he> many sections (in the Torah) adjoin one another, and yet are (mentally) as far from one another &c.

Sabb. I, 2 ס׳ למנחה near Minḥah time; a. v. fr.—Esp. סְמוּכִין, סְמוּכִים the interpretation founded on the fact of local junction of texts (v. supra). Yeb. l. c. ס׳ מן התורה מנין where is it intimated that Biblical texts are to be interpreted on the basis of proximity? Answ. (ref. to Ps. CXI, 8): they are arranged &c.
<cite ref="Psalms 111:8">Ib.</cite> <he>מאן דלא דריש ס׳</he> he who does not adopt the interpretation based on textual proximity.
Ber. 10ᵃ; a. fr.—b) strong, hardened.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite> <he>לבה ס׳ עליהם</he> her heart is hardened towards them (and their presence will prevent her from confessing her guilt); cmp. <cite ref="C00445"><he>גּוּס</he> I</cite>.
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: to be adjoined. Ber. l. c. למה נִסְמְכָה וכ׳ why has the section referring to Absalom (Ps. III) been joined to that relating to Gog and Magog (Ps. II)? Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 20 ונ׳ להר וכ׳ and is close to the mountain opposite.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 28a">M. Kat. 28ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be ordained. Snh. l. c., v. supra.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 87a:5">Yoma 87ᵃ</cite> <he>שראויין לִיסָּמֵךְ</he> who are worthy to be ordained; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to support, prop. Y. Maasr. II, 50ᵃ top המְסַמֵּךְ בגפנים he who props vines.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 244:4">Yalk. Ex. 244</cite> <he>עוזר ומסמך אתה וכ׳</he> thou art a helper and supporter to all &c.; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>מְסוּמָּךְ</he>, pl. <he>מְסוּמָּכִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:2">Kel. II, 2</cite> <he>יושבין שלא מ׳</he> (vessels or fragments of vessels) resting without the need of a support.

senses.gloss: to pack, tread. Y. Maasr. l. c. ברגליו מַסְמִיךְ working with his feet is he who packs (sheaves &c.; Y. B. Mets. VII, beg. 11ᵇ מקמץ).

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45">Gen. R. s. 45</cite>, end <he>היתה מִסְתַּמֶּכֶת על וכ׳</he> was leaning on her handmaid.
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 131:2">Sifré Num. 131</cite> <he>והיה מִסְתַּמֵּךְ וכ׳</he> and he went off leaning on his stick; a. e.
